newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: FOCUS-Heineken profit dips, seen recovering.
newsitem.headline: FOCUS-Heineken profit dips, seen recovering.

text.p: Heineken, Europe's biggest brewer, on Friday reported a slight dip in 1996 profits but its shares gained as the bourse welcomed results at the high end of market expectations and a forecast for profit growth in 1997.
Net profits last year totalled 655 million guilders ($342 million), down slightly from 664 million in 1995, with net profit per share of 13.06 guilders versus 13.24.

Analysts had expected net profit of between 630 and 660 million guilders and the company's shares staged a brief, sharp rally after suffering a short hangover from rival Grolsch's earlier gloomy profits and outlook.
